findings.text: the quoted source-liveness receipt reports one global edge, projection and cache drop but names neither the calorimetry source nor the responsible run; the surrounding before/after evidence makes the attribution plausible, but the receipt itself does not independently identify which source was detached.

no automated regression test or recurring exact-source gate was armed, so a later loss of the accepted attachment or weakening of either refusal would not fail a durable check; the committed evidence preserves what happened but does not enforce that the live state remains true.

the causal source-liveness log is referenced at a shared mutable application-log path without a retained copy or digest, which weakens later independent reproduction of the edge-loss diagnosis after that log rotates or changes.

justifications.durability: manifest.md:11-12 explicitly leaves both suites unarmed, while the committed evidence and change-ledger identity preserve a strong historical record but supply no test that fails if the exact live attachment or refusal predicates regress.
justifications.evidence: manifest.md:9 and docs/evidence/sn-west-catalog-release/the-three-withheld-sources.md:13-147 record 3/3 before rows, both real guard refusals, the governed attachment, and an exact postflight, although the calorimetry detachment attribution rests on an aggregate reconcile receipt.
justifications.fit: docs/evidence/sn-west-catalog-release/the-three-withheld-sources.md:149-162 uses the repository's governed attach command, bounded graph reads, dry-run refusals, project-absolute evidence links, and no ad-hoc mutation or forbidden source naming.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/sn-west-catalog-release/the-three-withheld-sources.md:13-17 gives every requested source a final disposition and lines 57-147 prove one accepted validation-valid binding plus two source-specific exclusions as the goal permits.
justifications.scope_discipline: manifest.md:3 and the c5821adac..dd30581b4 diff agree exactly on the three declared documentation paths, with no product, test, generated, or unrelated file in either commit.
